boxes.title: Manifest loads; contract_version is supported; ceiling and scopes are within the agreed values
Exactly one TurnResult per turn; first sentence and whole turn within budget
A repeated turn_id replays without re-running
Every sentence passes the speech rules, for every persona tier
Suspend finishes within 2 s and produces no output; resume continues from the saved step; cancel is silent
No synchronous network or file calls; no database access (reads through ctx.data, changes through ctx.actions)
Publishing above the ceiling fails; every event has an expiry; scheduled nudges use deliver_at
run_background (if used) stops cleanly when cancelled
Integration keys come only from ctx.secrets; nothing sensitive in logs
